**Analyzing the Ecuador vs. Germany World Cup 2026 Match (Hypothetically)**

Okay, so I need to create a JSON prediction for a future World Cup match – Ecuador vs. Germany on June 25th, 2026. My initial instinct is to jump right in and start searching for the data. I'll need the official 23-man squads for both teams, their recent form (ideally their last ten matches), any relevant pre-match news headlines, recent stats, and, of course, bookmaker odds to inform my prediction.

Wait a second… the date is 2026. It's May 2024 right now, so there's *no actual* 2026 World Cup data available yet! The prompt does remind me to only predict information about a match that has not yet been played, and to not use any information published after the kickoff time.

Right, I need to adjust my approach. Since I'm essentially making a *hypothetical* prediction, I need to use the current information available for Ecuador and Germany as a proxy. I will search for the current squads and recent form, looking at the recent matches for both the Ecuador national football team and the Germany national football team, and use that information to make an informed prediction for this future match.
